Advocate for the Petitioner : Mr D Medhi
Advocate for the Respondent : Pp, Assam
 Before
 The Hon'Ble Mr Justice Arun Dev Choudhury
 Order

18.09.2023 Page No.# 2/2 This is an application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. praying for anticipatory bail to the petitioners, Bandana Deka and Arup Das in connection with Nalbari PS case No.
389/2023 under Section 498A/313/506/294/34 IPC.

Page No.# 1/2 vs The State Of Assam on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188349642/
1
I have perused the FIR as well as the documents available on record.
Also considered the submissions made at the bar.
Call for the Case Diary fixing 12-10-2023.
Heard on the prayer of interim anticipatory bail.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case including the nature and gravity of the offence, it is hereby provided that, in the event of arrest,
the applicants above named shall be allowed to go on pre-arrest bail on furnishing a bond of Rs.
20,000/- each with one local surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority.

It is,
however, made clear that the applicants shall appear before the Investigating Officer within 02 weeks from today for recording their statements.
